blocks.text: Dennis Trillo capped a week of heightened public attention with a career milestone after he became the only artist to receive two trophies at the Golden Screen Awards: Dekada Awards 2026 on Sunday, October 4. Trillo was recognized for his performances in the films “Felix Manalo” (2015) and “Green Bones” (2024) during the ceremony, which was held at the MMFF Auditorium in Pasig City. The awards were given as Trillo has been at the center of public attention over the past week following Patrick Garcia’s interview with Ogie Diaz, in which Garcia discussed his past relationship with Mercado and their son, […]...
